title: How to Introduce a New Skincare Product
seo_title: How to Introduce a New Skincare Product Safely
seo_description: A measured guide to patch testing, pacing, and adding a new skincare product to your routine.
focus_keyword: how to introduce a new skincare product
excerpt: A measured guide to patch testing, pacing, and adding a new skincare product to your routine.
content:
Start slowly

Introducing one product at a time makes it easier to understand how it fits into your routine. Follow the product label for frequency and application guidance.

Patch test first

When suitable, apply a small amount to a discreet area and allow time to observe how your skin responds. A patch test cannot guarantee that a product will suit everyone, but it is a helpful precaution.

Keep the rest familiar

  • Use a simple cleanser and moisturising routine.
  • Avoid introducing several new products on the same day.
  • Use daytime sun protection as part of your regular routine.

Give your routine time before deciding whether to make another change.

Stop use if irritation occurs. For ongoing concerns, consult a qualified dermatologist.
